text: Federated learning does not eliminate privacy risk, because although the data stays decentralized the protocol still exchanges model parameters, and those parameters can expose sensitive information if intercepted or improperly handled.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance Via Web3 Reputation System (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4941807

isBasedOn.name: AI Governance Via Web3 Reputation System

abstract: These challenges arise because, while FL keeps data decentralized, it still involves the exchange of model parameters, which could potentially expose sensitive information if intercepted or improperly handled.
